questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

UCE : FEX :: PGS : TIS :: HKR : ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• First letter → (3) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• Second letter → (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

​So,

 
• UCE : FEX

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a75efa6ebcc270159a4a7079635cd7bb1730c74836da936b6e9827940653e904.png] 

And,

 
• PGS : TIS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b27f849499287b6517495fb3994ef635d6998e8a8a35374dc0cd076587412c0.png] 

Similarly,

 
• HKR : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b35edacbfd812d0f7336bd4c1b5ad3969a870a7ab24a439d6ed425b3b261ea0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "SMK".
